ownership: All concrete staging is agent-authored, not a requester lock. Strict scene gates evaluate the chosen test concept independently from protocol hard gates.
gate_policy: whole-scene pass requires every gate to pass with visible evidence; missing/partially occluded key contact is partial or fail, not pass.

gates.criterion: Military unit ceremony is readable through structured olive uniforms, coherent collar/shoulder detail and a waiting measured formation in a parade courtyard.
A reference-guided woman actively settles a comrade’s shoulder-cord while he waits, rather than both merely posing.
Her right pinch beside his left epaulette, her left support below, cord shoulder attachment and the entire continuous hanging loop are visible together and physically coherent.
The main face retains the observed large brown eyes, softly rounded small nose and softly full pink lips, without substituting a generic unrelated face.
Dark straight chin-length bob and fine separated wispy fringe remain visible and close to the reference.
Face, action, patient comrade, waiting formation and courtyard context form one understandable photographic instant with coherent bodies.
